summary: HF Sinclair filed an 8-K reporting a Stock Purchase Agreement dated November 3, 2026 with REH Advisors Inc., now parent of the former Sinclair Companies, to repurchase 2,100,000 shares in a privately negotiated transaction at $110.81 per share, roughly $233 million aggregate, funded from cash on hand and expected to close on or around November 6, 2026. Shares become treasury stock. It is the 24th such negotiated buyback and falls under the August 26, 2026 $1.5 billion program, of which $1 billion is used and about $493 million remains. Watch residual selling-stockholder overhang and authorization pace.
